resources.string: Clearer zoom help for the simulated sky and camera.
Use two fingers to zoom in either viewing mode.
The 0°/90° control stays visible and explainable in the camera tutorial.
Tutorial explanations leave the axis control clear in landscape.
With landscape islands visible, 0°/90° stays beside the chevron; with islands collapsed, it stays below Menu.
